name: shortest_path_unweighted
author: ae9bcafc
description: Finds a path with the fewest edges between two nodes using breadth-first search. Use it for minimum-hop, fewest-flight, or degrees-of-separation questions. It supports directed and undirected graphs and deliberately ignores edge weights. It returns the labelled path and its hop count.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

source.description: Exact id of the starting node; use lookup_node if only a name is known.

target.description: Exact id of the destination node; use lookup_node if only a name is known.
